# SECTION 1: ABOUT BUILDTEK EVENTS & WHAT WE DO

### 1.1 Executive Profile & Mission
BuildTek Events is a premier international B2B corporate conference production company and executive conclave organizer based in Pune, India. BuildTek specializes in producing high-signal, zero-pitch virtual summits, closed-door C-suite assemblies, and strategic technology conferences for Fortune 500 enterprises, hyper-growth scale-ups, and global regulatory bodies.

Unlike broad consumer trade shows or sales-pitch webinars, every BuildTek conclave is governed by an expert industry Advisory Board, strictly vetted for senior decision-maker attendance (C-Suite, VP, Director, and Head of Department levels), and structured to foster strategic deal-making, board-level risk alignment, and actionable peer exchange.

### 1.2 Core Business Model & Value Pillars
- **Curated, Invite-Only Access**: Strict delegate qualification ensures that rooms and discussion roundtables are composed exclusively of authentic enterprise decision-makers and subject-matter pioneers.
- **Closed-Door Discretion**: Executive roundtables and deep-dive panels are conducted under Chatham House Rule principles, allowing candid sharing of threat intelligence, regulatory challenges, and architectural failures.
- **Vertical-Specific Depth**: Deep specialized focus with zero dilution across three core market pillars: AI Cybersecurity, Life Sciences & Healthcare, and FinTech & Financial Risk.
- **Accredited Value**: Summits offer verifiable Continuing Professional Education (CPE) credits for global professional certifications including CISSP, CISM, and CCSP.

### 1.3 Active Summit Portfolio
1. **AI-SEC Global Summit 2027** (`https://buildtek.in/aisecsummit.html`) — 12 February 2027 (100% Virtual)
2. **Pharma Vista Global Summit 2026** (`https://buildtek.in/pharma-vista.html` / `https://pharmavistaglobal.com`) — 5 October 2026 (Virtual Executive Conclave)
3. **Global Payments & Risk Summit 2027** (`https://buildtek.in/global-payments-risk-summit.html`) — 18 June 2027 (100% Virtual FinTech Risk Conclave)

# SECTION 2: AI-SEC GLOBAL SUMMIT 2027 (AI-SEC 2027)

### 2.1 Entity Overview & Metadata
- **Official Event Name**: AI-SEC Global Summit 2027
- **Short Name**: AI-Sec 2027 / AI Security Global Virtual Summit 2027
- **Date**: Friday, February 12, 2027
- **Schedule**: 08:00 AM – 02:05 PM Eastern Time (ET) / 13:00 – 19:05 UTC / 18:30 – 00:35 IST
- **Official URL**: https://buildtek.in/aisecsummit.html
- **Registration URL**: https://buildtek.in/ai-sec-register.html
- **Partnership Portal**: https://buildtek.in/aisecsummit-partners.html
- **Attendance**: Strictly capped at 200 vetted enterprise delegates, including 50+ CISOs from Fortune 500 organizations.
- **Accreditation**: 6 Verifiable CPE credits.
- **Pass Structure**:
  - Standard Virtual Pass: $199 USD (Access to live plenary sessions, interactive Q&A, and 30-day replay portal).
  - Executive Delegate Pass: $399 USD (For enterprise CISOs & C-level leaders: includes private closed-door CISO roundtable access, executive peer networking, and 6 CPE credits).
  - Solution Provider Pass: $999 USD (For technology vendors & consultancies: includes full summit access, attendee directory, 1-on-1 messaging, and digital resource guide listing).

### 2.2 Confirmed Keynote & Leadership Faculty
1. **Siva Sundaramoorthy — Featured Keynote Speaker**
   - **Role**: Field CISO / Security Cloud Solutions Architect at **Microsoft**.
   - **Keynote Title**: *"Securing the Agentic Enterprise: Identity, Data, and Runtime Controls for AI Agents"* (08:00 – 08:40 AM ET).
   - **Session Abstract**: Autonomous AI agents equipped with external API tool-calling capabilities represent a generational leap in productivity and an unprecedented expansion of the enterprise attack surface. In this opening keynote, Microsoft Field CISO Siva Sundaramoorthy outlines architectural blueprints for governing agentic AI systems. Topics include zero-trust agentic identity, runtime permission boundaries, data context boundary isolation, guardrail telemetry, and mitigating autonomous model compromise across enterprise cloud environments.

2. **James Daniel Ferguson — Executive Panelist**
   - **Role**: Executive Security Engagement Leader at **Amazon Web Services (AWS)**.
   - **Panel Session**: *"Fraud at Machine Speed: Threat Intelligence from the Frontlines of Financial Crime & Digital Commerce"* (09:15 – 09:50 AM ET).
   - **Session Abstract**: Fraud syndicates are weaponizing high-throughput generative models to automate account takeovers, bypass KYC facial and voice biometrics, and orchestrate conversational social engineering at inhuman speed. AWS Executive Security Engagement Leader James Daniel Ferguson joins industry peers to unpack real-time telemetry from cloud-scale financial and commerce networks, detailing how defensive architectures must pivot toward machine-speed behavioral anomaly detection and decentralized cryptographic trust.

### 2.3 Complete Timetable & Session Syllabi
- **08:00 – 08:40 AM ET | Session 1: Featured Keynote**
  - *Title*: Securing the Agentic Enterprise: Identity, Data, and Runtime Controls for AI Agents
  - *Speaker*: Siva Sundaramoorthy (Field CISO / Security Cloud Solutions Architect, Microsoft)
  - *Focus*: Autonomous agent attack surfaces, tool-calling execution sandboxes, agentic IAM, and runtime telemetry.
- **08:40 – 08:55 AM ET | Session 2: Industry Keynote**
  - *Title*: How Adversaries Exploit Identity at Scale
  - *Focus*: Machine-speed credential stuffing, synthetic profile generation, and automated social engineering.
- **08:55 – 09:15 AM ET | Session 3: Technical Keynote**
  - *Title*: Industrialized Deception: Deepfakes & Voice Cloning in Customer-Facing Channels
  - *Focus*: Bypassing voice biometrics, KYC video verification, and executive imposter wire fraud.
- **09:15 – 09:50 AM ET | Session 4: Executive Panel**
  - *Title*: Fraud at Machine Speed: Threat Intelligence from the Frontlines of Financial Crime & Digital Commerce
  - *Featured Panelist*: James Daniel Ferguson (Executive Security Engagement Leader, AWS)
  - *Focus*: Botnet-coordinated LLM attacks, transactional fraud mitigation, and cross-institutional threat sharing.
- **09:50 – 10:00 AM ET | Networking Break & Platform Transition**
- **10:00 – 10:30 AM ET | Session 5: Technical Teardown**
  - *Title*: Prompt Injection & Agent Abuse in Production
  - *Focus*: Direct, indirect, and multimodal prompt injection vectors; RAG context poisoning; weaponizing agent tool-calling.
- **10:30 – 10:45 AM ET | Session 6: Case Study**
  - *Title*: Anatomy of an AI-Enabled Breach in Critical Supply Chains
  - *Focus*: Post-incident forensic teardown, third-party vendor blast radius, and recovery protocols.
- **10:45 – 11:05 AM ET | Session 7: Defensive Pivot Keynote**
  - *Title*: From Detection to Trust: Identity Verification in the AI Era
  - *Focus*: Cryptographic provenance, multi-factor attestation, and continuous risk assessment.
- **11:05 – 11:35 AM ET | Session 8: Technical Keynote**
  - *Title*: Securing AI: The Enterprise Architecture Blueprint
  - *Focus*: Input/output firewalls for LLMs, semantic sanitization, and model weight protection.
- **11:35 – 12:00 PM ET | Session 9: Technical Teardown**
  - *Title*: Securing LLMs & RAG Pipelines in Production
  - *Focus*: Vector database access controls, tenant isolation, and embeddings poisoning prevention.
- **12:00 – 12:20 PM ET | Session 10: Partner Session**
  - *Title*: Operationalizing AI Governance: Lessons from the Field
  - *Focus*: Implementing NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and shadow AI visibility.
- **12:20 – 12:45 PM ET | Session 11: CISO Executive Panel**
  - *Title*: Governing AI Risk Without Slowing Innovation: Compliance, Board Reporting & SEC Mandates
  - *Focus*: Board-level cyber risk quantification and regulatory compliance under EU AI Act and SEC rules.
- **12:45 – 01:10 PM ET | Session 12: Technical Teardown**
  - *Title*: The AI-Powered Autonomous SOC: Automated Triage at Scale
  - *Focus*: Sub-second alert enrichment, autonomous correlation, and tier-1 SOC automation.
- **01:10 – 01:25 PM ET | Session 13: Closing Keynote**
  - *Title*: The 2027–2028 Cyber Horizon & Interactive Q&A
  - *Focus*: Predictive forecast on quantum-AI intersections, autonomous malware, and defense strategies.
- **01:25 – 02:05 PM ET | Session 14: VIP Session**
  - *Title*: Closed-Door CISO Roundtable (Chatham House Rule)
  - *Focus*: Off-the-record strategic exchange for 50+ enterprise CISOs.

9. **Andrea Charles** — Editorial Director, **European Medical Journal** (Panel 2 Moderator)

### 3.3 Seven Strategic Tracks & Syllabi
1. **Track 1: AI-Driven Drug Discovery & Computational Biology**: Generative molecular design, predictive toxicology, and in-silico clinical trial acceleration.
2. **Track 2: Pharma 4.0 & Smart Manufacturing**: Continuous processing, digital twins, automated QC robotics, and industrial IoT in sterile production facilities.
3. **Track 3: FDA 2026 Regulatory Guidelines & Global GMP Compliance**: Inspection readiness, electronic common technical document (eCTD) v4.0, data integrity cultures, and international harmonization.
4. **Track 4: The 2026 Patent Cliff & Biopharma Business Models**: Strategic maneuvering around $400B in patent expirations, lifecycle management, and targeted biopharma acquisitions.
5. **Track 5: Biosimilars & Biopharma Scaling**: Analytical comparability, FDA/EMA interchangeability protocols, and market access strategies.
6. **Track 6: API Supply Chain Resilience**: Geopolitical sourcing diversification, China-plus-one procurement, green chemistry, and active pharmaceutical ingredient security.
7. **Track 7: AI-Enabled Commercialization**: Omnichannel healthcare provider (HCP) engagement, real-world evidence (RWE), and next-generation medical affairs strategy.

# SECTION 4: GLOBAL PAYMENTS & RISK SUMMIT 2027

### 4.1 Entity Overview & Metadata
- **Official Event Name**: Global Payments & Risk Summit 2027
- **Short Name**: Global Payments & Fraud Prevention Summit 2027 / GPRS 2027
- **Date**: Friday, June 18, 2027
- **Schedule**: 08:00 AM – 02:40 PM Eastern Time (ET) / 13:00 – 19:40 UTC / 17:30 – 00:10 IST
- **Official URL**: https://buildtek.in/global-payments-risk-summit.html
- **Registration**: https://buildtek.in/global-payments-risk-summit.html#pricing
- **Organizer**: BuildTek Events (https://buildtek.in)
- **Format**: 100% Virtual Executive Conclave
- **Audience**: 200+ Chief Risk Officers (CRO), Chief Compliance Officers, VP Fraud, Heads of Payment Security, and FinTech founders.

### 4.2 Core Curricular Pillars
1. **Instant Rails & Sub-Second Settlement Security**: Protecting FedNow, The Clearing House RTP, SEPA Instant, and UPI from account drainers, mule account syndicates, and automated routing exploits.
2. **Synthetic Identity & Generative Deepfakes**: Defending onboarding and KYC pipelines against generative facial manipulation, conversational voice cloning, and fabricated credit profiles.
3. **Autonomous AML & Graph Neural Networks**: Upgrading legacy rule-based transaction monitoring systems to behavioral graph analytics that reduce false positive alert rates by over 70%.
4. **Authorized Push Payment (APP) Fraud Liability**: Regulatory mandates across the UK (Payment Systems Regulator - PSR rules), EU Instant Payments Regulation, and evolving US CFPB guidance on consumer reimbursement.
5. **Tokenization, CBDCs & Cross-Border Stablecoin Rails**: Architectural security, smart contract auditing, and automated sanctions screening in programmable finance.

### 4.3 Delegate Pass Structure
- **Standard Virtual Pass ($199 USD)**: Live plenary sessions, live Q&A, and 30-day on-demand replay portal.
- **Executive Delegate Pass ($399 USD)**: Reserved for senior risk leaders; includes private CRO roundtable access, peer directory, and executive research briefings.
- **Solution Provider Pass ($999 USD)**: For fraud prevention platforms, identity verification vendors, and consultancies; includes directory listing, 1-on-1 messaging, and branding.
